lead.topic: Amaran: the hero is Mukund, but the story is told through Indhu
lead.insight: Amaran is based on Major Mukund Varadarajan (Ashoka Chakra, killed in Shopian in 2014). Everyone knows the ending, so the film moves the suspense: the first half shows Mukund through his wife Indhu's eyes, the second half is her wait. The question is not 'will he come back' but 'how will she bear it'. Point-of-view narration.

caption: Amaran's hero is Major Mukund. But the story is told by Indhu.

The real Major Mukund Varadarajan married Indhu Rebecca Varghese in 2009 and was killed in Shopian in 2014 (Ashoka Chakra). We all know the ending, so the film moves the suspense to Indhu: not 'will he come back?' but 'how will she bear it?'. That is point-of-view narration. Its director, Rajkumar Periasamy, made O.M, out now.
Did you cry for Mukund or for Indhu?
Send this to the friend who cried at Amaran.
